name: codex-workbench
description: Cross-platform plugins for a personal Codex workbench

scripts.check: node tooling/check-repository.mjs && pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-contracts check && pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-server check && pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-web lint && pnpm --filter "./plugins/*" --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-web typecheck
scripts.test: node --test tooling/check-repository.test.mjs tooling/collect-agentero-licenses.test.mjs tooling/app-sdk-debug.test.mjs tooling/build-agentero-branding.test.mjs && pnpm --filter "./plugins/*" --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-web --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-contracts --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-server test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-contracts build && pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-server build && pnpm --filter "./plugins/*" --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-web build
